thought.text: The login page is a Vue SPA. Let me test authentication using the meta CSRF token.

reasoning_content:
The signin page is a Vue SPA. The form is rendered client-side. CSRF token is in meta csrf-token. I can POST with that token and email/password. Let me test login via curl with the meta token.

Actually Devise's SPA might use a JSON API. Let's try POST with the csrf token in header, form-encoded.

action.command: cd /tmp && TOKEN=$(grep -oE 'name="csrf-token" content="[^"]+"' s.html | sed 's/.*content="//;s/"//') && echo "token=${TOKEN:0:20}..." && echo "---POST login (form)---" && curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o lr.html -w "code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in -H "X-CSRF-Token: $TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@example.org" --data-urlencode "user[password]=UxbuS7Zp8BNM" --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" && echo "---authed GET /---" && curl -s -b cj.txt -o after.html -w "code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/ && grep -oE '"current_user":\{[^}]*\}' after.html | head -c 400; echo; grep -oE '"email":"[^"]*"' after.html | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && TOKEN=$(grep -oE 'name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]+\"' s.html | sed 's/.*content=\"//;s/\"//') && echo \"token=${TOKEN:0:20}...\" && echo \"---POST login (form)---\" && curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o lr.html -w \"code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in -H \"X-CSRF-Token: $TOKEN\" --data-urlencode \"user[email]=admin@example.org\" --data-urlencode \"user[password]=UxbuS7Zp8BNM\" --data-urlencode \"authenticity_token=$TOKEN\" && echo \"---authed GET /---\" && curl -s -b cj.txt -o after.html -w \"code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download} redirect=%{redirect_url}\\n\" http://localhost:3000/ && grep -oE '\"current_user\":\\{[^}]*\\}' after.html | head -c 400; echo; grep -oE '\"email\":\"[^\"]*\"' after.html | head", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Authenticate with admin credentials"}
